actions.reason: Inspect visible workspace for any existing files or project structure before implementing the requested transcript artifact
Define the task-specific success criteria from the original request so verification can target the actual deliverable

args.objective: Download the referenced YouTube video of someone playing Zork, transcribe the entire on-screen text, and create /app/solution.txt containing every player input move one per line in the order shown.
required_artifacts: a local copy or accessible download of the referenced video if obtainable in the workspace
required_behaviors: The solution.txt file must list all player-entered moves from the video, one per line, preserving order and text exactly as shown where legible.
The transcript must be derived from the video content, not guessed or fabricated.
If the video can be downloaded locally, the downloaded asset should be present for inspection/verification.
known_invalid_patterns: Answers inferred from memory or external knowledge without inspecting the video
File existence without evidence that the moves were extracted from the video
Transcripts that omit moves, reorder them, or include non-move narration as moves
verification_plan: Inspect workspace and available tools for a way to fetch or access the video.
Obtain the video or an accessible representation of its content.
Extract the sequence of player inputs from the video and write them to /app/solution.txt.
Verify the file contents against the extracted evidence, ideally by comparing against the video transcript or frame/text captures.
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence of the video acquisition or access method used
Receipt-backed evidence showing the extracted move sequence
Receipt-backed evidence showing /app/solution.txt contents match the extracted sequence

actions.reason: Record a concise working plan for the multi-step media extraction task

args.objective: Produce /app/solution.txt with the full ordered list of Zork moves from the referenced video, based on the video itself.
args.current_focus: Find a way to access/download the video and extract on-screen text or captions.
implementation_approach: Inspect workspace and available tools for download/access options.
If direct download tools are unavailable, look for any visible helper scripts or browserless extraction utilities in the workspace.
Extract the move sequence from the video content using whatever visible evidence is obtainable.
Write the moves one per line to /app/solution.txt.
validation_strategy: Confirm the extracted sequence is grounded in visible video evidence.
Check that /app/solution.txt contains the same ordered moves.
Prefer evidence from receipts over assumptions.
verification_test_strategy: Use the strongest visible check available after extraction, such as comparing the written file to the extracted transcript or frame notes.
Avoid treating file existence alone as sufficient.
known_bad_behavior: Guessing moves from memory or external sources
evidence_gaps: No transcript or move sequence extracted yet
risks: Video may require alternate access methods if direct download is unavailable
next_steps: Acquire or access the video content
evidence_required_before_finalization: Receipt-backed comparison or verification against the extracted sequence
